title: Veiled Rituals
changes: At noon the Veiled Circle holds a ritual in the land it fights hardest for: a glowing rune circle guarded by three acolytes.
Veiled heroes standing in the circle speed the ritual up. If it completes, the Veiled gain ground in that land.
Heroes sworn against the Veiled can stand in the circle to stall it, or slay all three acolytes to break it for valor and renown.
